remarks: Discover modern living in this stunning open-concept 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo in the heart of Downtown Stamford. The spacious primary suite boasts a walk-in closet, an en-suite bath, and private balcony access, perfect for enjoying city views. The sunlit living area also opens to the balcony. The second bedroom also includes a spacious walk-in closet, providing ample storage. This home features in-unit laundry, abundant natural light, and an unbeatable location directly across from Mill River Park. You'll be just moments from UConn Stamford, top-rated restaurants, premier shopping, entertainment, Ferguson Library, I-95, and the Stamford Train Station. Residents of The Mill River House enjoy exclusive amenities, including a fitness center, a beautifully landscaped courtyard, a grilling atrium, and a stylish clubroom for meetings and social gatherings.
